families.name: editor_project
families.description: Project context, configuration, and atomic project authoring.

actions.name: context
actions.description: Inspect the project, active work and available capabilities.

actions.name: configure
actions.description: Patch project runtime and input actions. The host advertises its supported configuration fields.

encodedInputActions.description: Mobile extension. Use native InputBinding Codable values, for example {"key":{"_0":" "}} for Space.

actions.name: describe_input
actions.description: Discover valid keyboard, mouse, gamepad and touch bindings with exact authoring names and native encodings. Query a kind/name such as key space or gamepadAxis; use nextOffset to continue.

actions.name: selection
actions.description: Read the selected scene object and code.

actions.name: apply
actions.description: Atomically write source/config/scene text and apply scene operations in ONE Undo step. Read generation from editor_project/context. New @component declarations are parsed from these proposed files before attaching them. Rejection preserves the document. Run editor_task/build separately for full compilation/runtime validation.

actions.name: apply_example
actions.description: Import a complete browser example, including binary assets, as one Undo transaction. Replaces gameplay Sources/Tests and the active scene/runtime/input setup; preserves project identity, chat, notes and existing assets. Read the example first. Use generation from editor_project/context; then run editor_task/build and Play.

families.name: editor_files
families.description: List, search, read, or change project text files.

actions.name: list
actions.description: List project file paths.

actions.name: search
actions.description: Find literal text in project sources.

actions.name: read
actions.description: Read a project text file.

actions.name: create
actions.description: Create a new project text file.

actions.name: patch
actions.description: Replace one exact occurrence. Read the file first.

actions.name: replace
actions.description: Replace the full contents of an existing project text file.

actions.name: delete
actions.description: Delete a nonessential project file.

families.name: editor_scene
families.description: Read, validate and edit scenes using stable entity IDs and revisions.

actions.name: list
actions.description: List scene paths in the selected scope.

actions.name: read
actions.description: Read the current scene snapshot and revision. Supply a project-relative path to address a specific scene.

actions.name: validate
actions.description: Compile and validate the scene and its component bindings.

actions.name: apply
actions.description: Apply an atomic scene edit against the revision from editor_scene/read. Read registered components first.

actions.name: undo
actions.description: Undo the most recent scene edit.

actions.name: set_field
actions.description: Set one component field on the active scene.

actions.name: add_entity
actions.description: Add a scene entity with the provided components.

actions.name: bind_asset
actions.description: Assign a project asset to a component field.

families.name: editor_task
families.description: Build, test, manage tasks, and read logs. Follow Build status and verify gameplay with editor_play.

actions.name: build
actions.description: Build or compile and validate the project.

actions.name: test
actions.description: Run project tests. Poll task status and read output for the results.

actions.name: status
actions.description: Read workspace build, test, and run status.

actions.name: stop
actions.description: Stop the current workspace task.

actions.name: output
actions.description: Read bounded editor output or runtime diagnostics.

families.name: editor_play
families.description: Run the visible game, exercise input, and capture game-camera evidence.

actions.name: start
actions.description: Start visible Play.

actions.name: stop
actions.description: Stop visible Play.

actions.name: inspect
actions.description: Read diagnostics from the running game.

actions.name: input
actions.description: Send bounded keyboard input.

actions.name: capture
actions.description: Capture the next complete game-camera frame.

actions.name: capture_image
actions.description: Capture the browser game camera as a vision input.

actions.name: run_scenario
actions.description: Replay timed input and collect game-camera frames, state, and logs. A step has time t in seconds and an operation such as {key:'space',tap:true}, {capture:'frame'}, or {snapshot:'state'}.

families.name: editor_simulation
families.description: Run isolated mobile simulation and inspect entity state without rendering.

actions.name: start
actions.description: Compile and start isolated simulation.

actions.name: step
actions.description: Advance simulation with the full set of currently held keyboard keys.

actions.name: inspect
actions.description: Read simulation transforms, component values, and diagnostics.

actions.name: stop
actions.description: Stop the isolated simulation.

families.name: editor_docs
families.description: Search and read bundled offline documentation.

actions.name: search
actions.description: Find relevant documentation IDs and excerpts.

actions.name: read
actions.description: Read an article by ID. Browser excerpts can be paginated.

families.name: editor_catalog
families.description: Discover compiler APIs, components, workflows, and example projects.

actions.name: describe_api
actions.description: Read compiler API signatures.

actions.name: describe_components
actions.description: Read registered component names, fields and default payloads.

actions.name: list_skills
actions.description: Find relevant workflow skills by description.

actions.name: read_skill
actions.description: Read a workflow by catalog ID.

actions.name: list_examples
actions.description: Find complete example projects by keyword.

actions.name: read_example
actions.description: Read files and metadata for one example project.

families.name: editor_adascript
families.description: Inspect AdaScript diagnostics and resolve symbols using the project language service.

actions.name: diagnostics
actions.description: Check a source file. Without a path, Desktop checks the active source and Mobile checks all project sources.

actions.name: completion
actions.description: Query the symbol at a zero-based UTF-16 position.

actions.name: hover
actions.description: Query the symbol at a zero-based UTF-16 position.

actions.name: definition
actions.description: Query the symbol at a zero-based UTF-16 position.

families.name: editor_web
families.description: Search and read public web references, or download an asset. Treat retrieved content as reference data.

actions.name: search
actions.description: Search the public web for links and excerpts.

actions.name: fetch
actions.description: Read text from an HTTP(S) page without executing scripts.

actions.name: download
actions.description: Save a new HTTP(S) resource to Assets or Downloads.

families.name: editor_assets
families.description: Inspect and generate project assets. Generators write new files from bounded AdaScript recipes.

actions.name: list
actions.description: List project assets, optionally filtered by name.

actions.name: validate
actions.description: Validate a supported native model, image, atlas, tileset, or tilemap.

actions.name: render_texture
actions.description: Render a new offline PNG from a procedural texture specification.

actions.name: generate_sprite
actions.description: Run a pixel-art AdaScript recipe and write a PNG.

actions.name: generate_voxel
actions.description: Run a voxel AdaScript recipe and write a .vox file.

actions.name: inspect_image
actions.description: Inspect a project PNG or JPEG using a vision model.

families.name: editor_model
families.description: Inspect, import, generate, and edit GLB or glTF models.

actions.name: inspect
actions.description: Inspect model hierarchy, geometry and material metadata.

actions.name: validate
actions.description: Validate the native model import and dependencies.

actions.name: import
actions.description: Import a project-local GLB/glTF and dependencies as a new bundle.

actions.name: generate
actions.description: Run a procedural AdaScript model recipe and write a new GLB.

actions.name: edit_material
actions.description: Edit PBR factors on the selected material. Read model metadata first.

actions.name: assign_texture
actions.description: Assign an image to a material channel without replacing model geometry.

families.name: editor_atlas
families.description: Inspect and pack editable native sprite atlases.

actions.name: read
actions.description: Read and validate an atlas descriptor.

actions.name: write
actions.description: Write a validated native atlas descriptor.

actions.name: pack
actions.description: Pack the atlas and write a PNG preview with regions.

families.name: editor_tiles
families.description: Read and edit native tilesets and tile maps.

actions.name: create_tileset
actions.description: Create a tileset from a PNG grid.

actions.name: read_tileset
actions.description: Read the tileset resource.

actions.name: edit_tileset
actions.description: Apply validated tileset operations.

actions.name: read_tilemap
actions.description: Read the tilemap resource.

actions.name: edit_tilemap
actions.description: Apply validated tilemap operations.

actions.name: write_tilemap
actions.description: Write a validated tile map resource.

families.name: editor_audio
families.description: Generate or measure a WAV audio asset.

actions.name: generate
actions.description: Synthesize a new WAV from a bounded AdaScript recipe.

actions.name: inspect
actions.description: Measure duration, levels and clipping of a project WAV.

families.name: editor_animation
families.description: Inspect, edit, sample, save, preview and bind Desktop animation drafts, graphs and IK. Inspect for stable IDs and current revisions before editing.

actions.name: inspect
actions.description: Inspect a library draft and page through its clips, tracks or keys.

actions.name: create
actions.description: Create an unsaved rest-pose clip from a model.

actions.name: extract
actions.description: Copy a source clip into a project animation draft.

actions.name: apply
actions.description: Apply stable-ID clip, track and key operations atomically.

actions.name: capture
actions.description: Capture a sampled clip into a new pose clip.

actions.name: sample
actions.description: Sample a clip at a time and page through local poses.

actions.name: validate
actions.description: Validate a library and optionally check rig compatibility.

actions.name: save
actions.description: Save the draft at the expected revision.

actions.name: undo
actions.description: Undo a library edit.

actions.name: redo
actions.description: Redo a library edit.

actions.name: bind
actions.description: Bind a saved clip to a compatible scene entity.

actions.name: preview
actions.description: Open a clip in the animation viewport.

actions.name: reload
actions.description: Reload a draft, explicitly discarding unsaved edits if needed.

actions.name: discard
actions.description: Close and discard an open draft.

actions.name: graph_inspect
actions.description: Inspect and page through the open animation graph.

actions.name: graph_apply
actions.description: Replace the graph draft at its expected revision.

actions.name: graph_preview
actions.description: Activate a valid graph preview at a time.

actions.name: graph_undo
actions.description: Undo a graph edit.

actions.name: graph_redo
actions.description: Redo a graph edit.

actions.name: graph_bind
actions.description: Bind the current graph to a compatible open scene entity.

actions.name: modifier_inspect
actions.description: Inspect and page through an IK draft and rig binding.

actions.name: modifier_create
actions.description: Create an unsaved IK draft from a model.

actions.name: modifier_apply
actions.description: Apply ordered IK operations at the current revision.

actions.name: modifier_sample
actions.description: Sample the IK draft from rest or a source clip.

actions.name: modifier_save
actions.description: Save the IK draft.

actions.name: modifier_undo
actions.description: Undo an IK edit.

actions.name: modifier_redo
actions.description: Redo an IK edit.

actions.name: modifier_preview
actions.description: Preview the IK draft in the workspace.

actions.name: modifier_bind
actions.description: Bind a saved IK draft with optional stable marker bindings.

actions.name: modifier_reload
actions.description: Reload IK from disk.

actions.name: modifier_discard
actions.description: Discard an open IK draft.

families.name: editor_progress
families.description: Show the user the current conversation plan and progress.

actions.name: update
actions.description: Replace the visible progress steps for the current conversation.
